answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 31819 Country: India Title: One bagger puton riksha a poudspeaker and bagging. We give him money that is right or wrong? Question: One bagger puton riksha a poudspeaker and bagging. We give him money that is right or wrong? Answer ID: 31819 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 695/583/B=1432) They are professional beggars and some are very rich, i.e. they are not eligible to receive zakah money. Those who pay 300 hundred rupees daily for their rickshaw rent, can they not arrange one hundred rupee for their food. One should take care giving zakah money to such beggars. Yes, if you want to help them from Imdad money you can do so. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
